subject: Strange behaviour of geom="bar": dodge becomes stack

messages.author: 8c45483022d450d5
messages.subject: Strange behaviour of geom="bar": dodge becomes stack
parts:
Hi

I notice a strange behaviour when using geom bar with 2 observations per x-axis unit. Dodge won't work in general with this, unless the two observations per unit are "identified" by a fill/colour. But if this fill/colour does not create a clear cut groups1/group 2 for each unit, then one has a mixed case of stack/dodge.

Maybe I am doing something wrong, should not use for example the stat identity?

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123)
df<-data.frame(country=rep(LETTERS[1:10], each=2), val=rnorm(20, mean=4), label=rep(c("cat 1", "cat2"),10), logic=sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), size=20, replace=TRUE))

### geom bar with two obs per unit: dodge will not work (takes max?)
qplot(data=df, x=country, y=val, geom="bar", position="dodge", stat="identity")

### geom bar with two obs per unit: dodge works if additional "classifier" is added:
qplot(data=df, x=country, y=val, geom="bar", fill=label, position="dodge", stat="identity")

### geom bar with two obs per unit: dodge does not work if additional "classifier" is not attributing each time to different group:
qplot(data=df, x=country, y=val, geom="bar", fill=logic, position="dodge", stat="identity")

###gives a mix of dodge/stack!

Thanks for your help!

Matthieu

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Strange behaviour of geom="bar": dodge becomes stack
parts:
I believe that without some sort of scale (fill, color, linetype, shape) it doesn't know what to dodge so it gives you the original plot. 

Due to stat="identity" you're getting overplotting and so it only looks like you have the maximum. The other bars are just hiding back there. :)

ggplot(data=df, aes(x=country, y=val))+geom_bar(position="dodge", stat="identity", alpha=0.5)

#The mixed dodge is the same problem. It doesn't know what to dodge
# and the "identity" tells it to plot it over itself.

qplot(data=df, x=country, y=val, geom="bar", fill=logic, position="dodge", stat="identity", alpha=0.5)
